name: Dark Angels
description: Dark Angels is a ransomware group that uses a 'big game hunting' strategy targeting a single high-value victim at a time rather than mass deployment. In July 2024 the group received a record-breaking $75 million ransom payment — the largest publicly confirmed ransomware payout in history. The group is notable for low-profile operations; Krebs reported it as the second most active by victim count as of early 2025.

sources.title: Low-Drama 'Dark Angels' Reap Record Ransoms — Krebs on Security
